title: Text: the prompt formula
drivingQuestion: How can I critically partner with Artificial Intelligence to build a digital portfolio that authentically represents who I am to the world?

hints.firstLength: Your first prompt is too short. Use the formula with labels: Role: ... Context: ... Task: ... Format: ...
hints.length: Make your next prompt at least 3 words longer than your previous accepted one. Keep the full formula: Role + Context + Task + Format. (Tip: add a detail about color, mood, or setting to grow it naturally.)
hints.structure: Use the prompt formula with all four labels: Role: ... Context: ... Task: ... Format: ...
hints.vocab: Use at least 2 of today's words in your prompt: energetic, creative, boring, paragraph, hobby, experience, interesting. (Role, Context, Task, Format are labels - they don't count.)
hints.promptGrammar: Include your experience using Present Perfect in the Context line: 'have' or 'has' + V3 (e.g., 'I have played football for 2 years').
hints.grammar: Please include an experience using 'have' or 'has' + V3 (e.g., 'I have played').
hints.textShort: Your text is too short. Add one more sentence about your experience.
hints.editNeeded: You must edit at least one character before publishing. Polish the AI draft - make it sound like YOU.
hints.evalNeeded: Write your critical review in both fields - what is good and what needs to change.
hints.empty: This field is still empty. Write something - even a simple sentence is fine.
